decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment. The pinned SDK doc still says the API is experimental, with execution gated on eligible credentials. No lifecycle change is shown. Every gate stays unknown; human dates are not renewed. This is the session SDK API, not GitHub Agentic Workflows.

citations.quote: Dynamic Workflows are extension-authored, session-scoped workflows that coordinate subagents and durable steps. The API is experimental.
still require eligible credentials (token-based billing or trusted HMAC authentication).
